{{Quote|Because of you, I have been able to make peace with Garrick. We can begin to repair the damage that has been done by Ter-Doac Vaine. It will take time, but I have hope once again. I've spoken to Garrick, and we both agree to allow you full access to our engine and weapon designs. This authorization will remain even if you decide to restart your career with the company.|Jonas Nova|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Jonas Nova''' was one of the two founders of [[Nova Orion Industries]], along with his old friend [[Garrick Orion]]. However, sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] they nearly [[Nova Orion Crisis|split the organization]] due to their growing mutual suspicion and distrust.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jonas Nova appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
